Confidence low — The balance sheet does not close exactly; figures drawn from the totals inherit that drift. Basis: input cost is measured against the company's own turnover for the same period, and the ceiling is the one this structural profile is graded on. Impact: EBITDA margin, as reported versus with input cost at the ceiling this profile is graded on moves from -3.6% to 32.9% (+36.6%). Input cost is the largest single line a mid-size fixed-asset-heavy operator carries, and it is repriced by suppliers faster than the company can reprice its own customers — the margin, not the volume, is what moves. Do this: 1) Negotiate index-linked price-review clauses into the largest supplier contracts — price-review clause covering the input lines behind 601 and 602, from the procurement lead (before the next annual price round). 2) Hedge the next two quarters of input volume — forward purchase cover schedule, by input line and delivery month, from the treasury team.
